name: hgi_xload_sram_b-fc210e160-tc-f9b

Knob: floorplan b = die 760 x 480, four 8-high macro columns in pin-facing pairs, centre logic. Bench: lockstep vs the flop x-load (every x-store write identical, 10 random commands) + MUT_T / MUT_M FAIL.
